school: 宗教改革发起人/维滕贝格大学神学教授/圣经翻译家/因信称义神学奠基人/圣诗创作者/教会改革制度设计者
historical_significance: 马丁·路德（1483-1546），生于艾斯莱本，矿工之子，埃尔福特大学法学转向奥古斯丁修会修士，1512年获维滕贝格大学神学博士并终身执教。1517年10月31日张贴《九十五条论纲》质疑赎罪券，引爆宗教改革；1520年连发《致德意志基督徒贵族公开书》《教会被掳巴比伦》《论基督徒的自由》三论著，系统提出唯经文、唯信心、唯恩典、信徒皆祭司的改革纲领；1521年沃尔姆斯帝国会议上面对皇帝查理五世拒绝撤回（'除非被圣经和理性说服'），遭帝国禁令后被萨克森选帝侯庇护于瓦尔特堡，十一周内把新约译成德语（1522年'九月约翻'），1534年出版完整德语圣经——以'家中母亲、街上孩子'的活语言为校准器，为德语铸成书面标准语的基座。他创立会众齐唱的德语圣咏（《上主是我坚固保障》）、写成《小要理问答》（1529）把全部核心神学压成家庭可教的问答体，并在《论世俗权威》（1523）中划出属灵权力与世俗权力的工具边界。他发动的改革重绘了欧洲宗教版图，其德语译本深刻塑造了现代德语，其天职观影响了后世的工作伦理。1546年逝于出生地艾斯莱本。
historical_significance_en: Martin Luther (1483-1546), born in Eisleben to a miner's family, turned from law at Erfurt to the Augustinian order, took his doctorate at Wittenberg in 1512 and taught there for life. His 95 Theses against indulgences, posted 31 October 1517, ignited the Reformation; in 1520 three treatises (To the Christian Nobility, The Babylonian Captivity, The Freedom of a Christian) laid out the program of Scripture alone, faith alone, grace alone, and the priesthood of all believers. At the Diet of Worms in 1521 he refused Emperor Charles V's demand to recant ('unless convinced by Scripture and plain reason'), and under the imperial ban, sheltered at the Wartburg, he translated the New Testament into German in eleven weeks (the September Testament, 1522), publishing the complete Luther Bible in 1534—calibrated to the living speech of 'the mother at home, the children in the street' and becoming the bedrock of the written German standard. He created congregational German hymnody (A Mighty Fortress Is Our God), compressed all core theology into the household-teachable Small Catechism (1529), and in On Secular Authority (1523) drew the tool-boundary between spiritual and worldly power. The movement he started redrew Europe's religious map, his Bible shaped modern German, and his doctrine of vocation shaped later work ethics. He died in Eisleben, his birthplace, in 1546.
description_zh: 路德的思维底色是'把裁决权从人移到可检验的源头，再把源头送到每个人手里'：面对不可解的神学焦虑，他不是在旧框架内加倍苦修，而是把罗1:17的一个所有格短语啃到语法翻转（塔楼经验），由此确立'因信称义'——在无人能及格的计分规则处更换判据。他的方法论四支柱：一是'唯独文本'（任何中间层权威都要回到共认的一手源头受检，且源头必须被译成众人的母语）；二是'新媒介杠杆'（押注印刷术换代窗口，用小册子、木刻与内容-视觉-渠道铁三角把一场神学争论变成欧洲事件）；三是'教理压缩'（把体系压成饭桌上可教完的问答体，并让框架自带复现协议）；四是'参与设计'（把弥撒从祭司独占改写为会众齐唱——产品结构决定参与结构）。他与权力的三次对峙（沃尔姆斯抗辩、帝国禁令、与农民战争及激进派的切割）显示同一原则的两面：立足点公开固定、不可协商；具体论点永远可以被文本与理性修正。
description_en: Luther's thinking was 'move judgment from men to a testable source, then put the source in everyone's hands': facing unresolvable theological anguish, he did not double his asceticism inside the old frame but chewed one genitive phrase of Romans 1:17 until its grammar flipped (the tower experience), establishing justification by faith—changing the scoring rule where no one could ever pass. His method rests on four pillars: sola scriptura (every intermediate authority tested against the shared primary source, and the source translated into the people's mother tongue); new-media leverage (betting on the printing-press shift window, with pamphlets, woodcuts and a content-image-channel triangle turning a theology dispute into a European event); catechetical compression (compressing the system into dinner-table Q&A with its own reproduction protocol); and participation design (rewriting the Mass from clerical monopoly into congregational singing—product structure determines participation structure). His three confrontations with power (the Worms declaration, the imperial ban, the break with radicals after the Peasants' War) show one principle's two faces: the standing point fixed publicly and non-negotiably, while specific points remain forever correctable by text and reason.

roles_en: Initiator of the Reformation (95 Theses, three treatises of 1520, the Worms declaration)
Bible translator (New Testament 1522, complete German Bible 1534)
Hymn writer and designer of congregational singing (A Mighty Fortress)
Catechist and parish-system designer (Small Catechism, parish visitations)
Prolific pamphleteer (German works commanding a vast share of the German print market)
